connector.name: Infimium
connector.registryDescription: Private AI context layer for semantic code search, dependency graphs, memory, and workspaces.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package infimium. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the aryankumar06 account. Treat it as community software and read the source before granting access to anything sensitive.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.
